chunks.arabic_text: اَلْكَافِي: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْجَبَّارِ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنِ الثَّعْلَبَةِ بْنِ مَيْمُونَ، عَنِ الزُّرَارَةِ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ

translations.en: Al-Kafi: Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Tha'laba ibn Maymun, from Zurara ibn A'yan, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ مَسَأَلَةٍ فَأَجَابَنِي، ثُمَّ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْهَا فَأَجَابَهُ بِخِلَافِ مَا أَجَابَنِي، ثُمَّ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ فَأَجَابَهُ بِخِلَافِ مَا أَجَابَنِي وَأَجَابَ صَاحِبِي، فَلَمَّا خَرَجَ الرَّجُلَانِ قُلْتُ: يَا ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ رَجُلَانِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِرَاقِ مِنْ شِيعَتِكُمْ قَدِمَا يَسْأَلَانِ فَأَجَبْتُ كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا بِغَيْرِ مَا أَجَبْتُ بِهِ صَاحِبَهُ؟

translations.en: I asked him about a matter so he answered me, then a man came to him and asked him about it so he answered him with a different answer to mine, then another man came so he answered him with a different answer to the one he gave me and the first man, so when the two men had exited I said: O son of the messenger of Allah, two men from the people of Iraq from among your followers came to ask you, but you answered each one of them with a different answer than the other?

chunks.arabic_text: فَقَالَ: يَا زُرَارَةُ! إِنَّ هَذَا خَيْرٌ لَنَا وَأَبْقَى لَنَا، وَلَكِنْ وَلَوْ اجْتَمَعْتُمْ عَلَى أَمْرٍ وَاحِدٍ لَصَدَّقَكُمْ النَّاسُ عَلَيْنَا، وَلَكَانَ أَقَلَّ لِبَقَائِنَا وَبَقَائِكُمْ

translations.en: He said: O Zurara, this is better and more safe for us and you, for if you were all to unite upon one position the people would believe you [in what you say] about us and that would be a threat to both our and your survival.

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ: ثُمَّ قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: شِيعَتُكُمْ لَوْ حَمَلْتُمُوهُمْ عَلَى السِّنَةِ أَوْ عَلَى النَّارِ لَمَضَوْا وَهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنْ عِنْدِكُمْ مُخْتَلِفِينَ، قَالَ: فَأَجَابَنِي بِمِثْلِ جَوَابِ أَبِيهِ

translations.en: He (Zurara) said: then I [later] said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): your followers, if you were to make them move in the face of arrows or on fire they would do it but they come out from you having differences! He said: so he answered me with the same reply as his father.

en.summary: This hadith explains the rationale behind the Imams providing different answers to the same question to different people. By varying their responses, the Imams prevented the general public from fully trusting their specific claims about themselves, thereby ensuring their political and physical survival (baqa') during times of persecution.
en.seo_question: Why did the Imams give different answers to the same question?
